items.raw_excerpt: The mood of Canterbury businesses is improving with the majority seeing the light at the end of the tunnel.

items.raw_excerpt: Trains on the Bangkok-Suvarnabhumi airport service suffered delays for the second day running on Tuesday, forcing the operator to bus commuters between the city centre and two destinations, including the airport.
items.summary_en: Trains on Bangkok's Airport Rail Link suffered delays for the second day in a row. The operator had to bus commuters between the city centre and the airport.

items.raw_excerpt: The stage is set for an exciting week of top netball action at the Oceania Netball World Cup qualifier in Tonga.
items.summary_en: The Oceania Netball World Cup qualifying tournament starts next week in Tonga. Teams from across the Pacific region will compete for spots in the Netball World Cup.

items.raw_excerpt: Copenhagen top in Happy City Index, exports hit new record and more news from Denmark on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Copenhagen has been ranked first in the Happy City Index. The city scored highest in quality of life measures. This news comes as Denmark's exports also reached a new record.

items.raw_excerpt: A broad area of low pressure is moving over Finland, bringing rain and windy weather to most of the country.
items.summary_en: A large area of low pressure is moving across Finland. It will bring rain and windy conditions to most parts of the country for the next three days.

items.raw_excerpt: The Munich family jeweller is known for pairing exceptional gemstones with iron, aluminium, bronze and wood – and for questioning what makes a jewel precious.
items.summary_en: A Munich family jeweller is known for pairing exceptional gemstones with unusual materials like iron, aluminium, bronze and wood. The jeweller is now bringing these unconventional high jewellery creations to Singapore.

items.raw_excerpt: Two shipments of frozen beef tongues imported from the United States were rejected at the border after testing positive for parasites, the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) said Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Two shipments of frozen beef tongues imported from the United States were rejected at Taiwan's border after tests found parasites. The Taiwan Food and Drug Administration announced the findings on Tuesday. The imports failed food safety inspection standards.

items.raw_excerpt: Sweden's new mobile phone alert system 'failed to deliver', Social Democrat leader says 'new direction for Sweden' is within reach, and more news from Sweden on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Sweden launched a new mobile phone emergency alert system, but the Social Democrat leader says it failed to deliver alerts to citizens. Opposition politicians are questioning the system's reliability. The government says improvements are being made.
